DAEMON_OPTS.description: Additional options that are passed to the Daemon.

PRIMARY_IP.description: The primary IP address for the STUN server to bind to.

SECONDARY_IP.description: The secondary IP address for the STUN server to bind to.

PRIMARY_PORT.description: The primary port for the STUN server.

SECONDARY_PORT.description: The secondary port for the STUN server.

DAEMON_USER.description: The user whom the daemons should run as.
